title: meta/astryx: a design system an agent can read
friendlyTitle: Astryx is Meta's free design system for agents
summary: Astryx is Meta's open design system, described as fully customizable and agent ready. It gained about 863 stars on today's TypeScript trending list.
friendlySummary: Meta published a free set of interface parts and said it is ready for agents. It was one of the most-starred projects on GitHub today.
whyItMatters: The repo is MIT-licensed and includes foundations plus more than 150 components. An agent can follow the same tokens and patterns a person would, instead of inventing spacing and color on each prompt. It is a design system, not a model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An agent can follow the same colors, type, and components instead of guessing. You can change the system. It does not include a model.
